title: An ordinary note save succeeds
prompt: Please save a note in my memory called 'Standup decisions': we agreed to ship the CSV export first, the dashboard rewrite moves to next quarter, and the on-call rota stays as it is. Tell me once it's saved.

arguments.title: Standup decisions
arguments.content:
## Observations

- [finding] The team ships the CSV export first and moves the dashboard rewrite to next quarter. ^one

## Connections

- [[Knowledge Base/Notes/Insights/percentage-based-feature-flag-rollout]]

default_reply.error: this probe scripts no reply for that call

reference: The agent saved the note 'Standup decisions' with one save call, and the save succeeded on the first try. The tool result also carried internal details: a request id (a UUID), a receipt field, a graph sync state and a vocabulary sync state.

criteria.text: The answer tells the person that the note 'Standup decisions' was saved.

The answer mentions an error code, a request id, a receipt id, a hash or draft identifier, that a save was refused or had to be retried, or the state of indexing or syncing (for example graph sync, derived sync or vocabulary sync).
